description: New Mexico motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in New Mexico?
questions.explanation: New Mexico helmet law: riders under 18.

provenance.manual: Helmet Law | Motor Vehicle Division NM

questions.q: What does New Mexico law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: New Mexico: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.
questions.remember: New Mexico between lanes: not allowed.

questions.q: What does New Mexico require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: New Mexico: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.
questions.remember: New Mexico eyewear: required unless there is a windshield.

questions.q: In New Mexico, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: New Mexico issues a motorcycle permit at 15 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: New Mexico motorcycle permit: 15 years at the earliest.

provenance.manual: Chapter 3: Instructional Permit | Motor Vehicle Division NM
